id: \bWelcome to the Clubsplosion. Would you like to enter? This years prize is a set of Vitamins.
en: \bWelcome to the Clubsplosion. Would you like to enter? This years prize is a set of Vitamins.
it: \bBenvenuto al Clubsplosion. Vuoi partecipare? Il premio di quest'anno è un set di Vitamine.

id: \bThe rules are simple. All you have to do is get to the other side of the room while beating the Trainers. Grab the Vitamins to win.
en: \bThe rules are simple. All you have to do is get to the other side of the room while beating the Trainers.  Grab the Vitamins to win.
it: \bLe regole sono semplici. Devi solo arrivare dall'altra parte della sala battendo gli Allenatori.  Prendi le Vitamine per vincere.

id: \bThe Clubsplosion is over. Come again next year.
en: \bThe Clubsplosion is over. Come again next year.
it: \bIl Clubsplosion è finito. Torna l'anno prossimo.
